name: Portfolio - GitHub Pages rebuild
description: Rebuild main after published V0 singleton changes. Add a repository-scoped Actions-write GitHub token in the remote Authorization header before enabling.

rule.filter: (before()._id in ["siteSettings", "homePage", "aboutPage", "contactPage"] && before()._type in ["siteSettings", "homePage", "aboutPage", "contactPage"]) || (after()._id in ["siteSettings", "homePage", "aboutPage", "contactPage"] && after()._type in ["siteSettings", "homePage", "aboutPage", "contactPage"])
